# opnsense_kea_dhcpv4_subnet (Data Source)

Reads an existing Kea DHCPv4 subnet on OPNsense by UUID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID to look up.

### Read-Only

- `allocator` (String) Address allocator.
- `description` (String) Description of the subnet.
- `match_client_id` (Boolean) Match clients by client-id.
- `ping_check` (Boolean) Ping the address before handing out a lease.
- `pools` (String) DHCPv4 pool definitions.
- `subnet` (String) IPv4 subnet in CIDR notation.
